examen.h1: What the CCSE Spanish citizenship exam is like
examen.desc: Dates, the 85 € fee, how to register and what the Instituto Cervantes CCSE test is like.
pie.noOficial: Independent website, not affiliated with the Instituto Cervantes. The questions come from the public official handbook of the Instituto Cervantes.
faq.1.q: Are these the official CCSE exam questions?
faq.1.a: Yes. They are the 300 questions from the official 2026 Instituto Cervantes handbook. The exam picks 25 of them, so if you understand them all, you pass.
faq.2.q: How much does the CCSE exam cost and when is it?
faq.2.a: The fee is 85 € and includes two attempts. There is an exam on the last Thursday of every month, except August and December.
faq.3.q: Is the exam in my language?
faq.3.a: No, the exam is always in Spanish. That's why here you see the question in Spanish and, below it, the translation and explanation in your language.
faq.4.q: What is free and what is paid?
faq.4.a: Free: 25 questions with explanations and 1 full mock exam. Full access costs {p}, one-time payment, for {d} days.
faq.5.q: Do I need to sign up?
faq.5.a: Not to start: your progress is saved on your device. If you create an account with your email, you can get it back on any phone or computer.
